label: Fly.io
about: What to look for in fly.toml: public services, volumes, secrets, auto stop and release commands. Files only.
tested: One fixture (fly.toml, Dockerfile), real model, 3 runs: the first two replies were refused whole by the harness because the model repeated command words from this note in prose; the wording was changed and the third run passed (68 s, $0.24): 8 of 9 planted found (secrets in [env], database port, plain port 80, moved mount, release command, suspend, large machine); missed: the production app name as its own item. NOT tested: several apps, Machines config in other files, a real organization. Not reviewed by a Fly.io specialist.
